messages:
Anna: Quick sketch + problem statement: moving sidebar groups to 'Workspaces / Models / Deployment' buckets. Concern: focus & back-button after deep-linking into a model.
Anna: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/console-nav-reorg (see frames 3-5)
Kevin: TL;DR: grouping makes sense, but when you open a model via external permalink we need clear URL semantics so Back goes where users expect.
Marta: Agree. Two concrete edge cases:
- user opens /models/model-123 via email permalink -> sidebar should highlight Models > Model 123 and breadcrumb reads "Workspace X / Models / Model 123".
- user navigates inside workspace to models list, opens model details as a drawer -> Back should close drawer, not navigate away from workspace.
Sam (PM): Good listing. The crux is: are deep links always full-page, or can they open drawers/panes depending on entry point? We need rules.
Josh: Proposed rule: permalink path decides rendering. If URL is /w/:workspaceId/models/:modelId then render full resource view. If user is already in UI and clicks a model row, use drawer (update URL with ?panel=drawer) so Back semantics are preserved.
Anna: +1 on query param for modal/drawer. Example URLs:
/w/alpha/models -> list
/w/alpha/models/123 -> full page (deep-linkable)
/w/alpha/models/123?panel=drawer -> layered drawer
Kevin: Nice. But watch out for duplicates in history: clicking row pushes ?panel=drawer; Back should pop that state. If someone opens /models/123 directly we shouldn't push the workspace list into history.
Marta: Accessibility nit: when drawer opens, focus must land on first interactive element and focus trap applied. When closed, focus returns to the row that opened it.
Anna: a11y-bot run on Figma prototypes flagged missing aria-current on sidebar items when group collapsed.
a11y-bot: Automated note: add aria-current="page" to active nav link; ensure skip-to-content link is present and tabbable early in DOM. (https://a11y.dev/aria/aria-current)
Sam (PM): Copy tweak: breadcrumb label for models should be "Models" (plural) not "Model". Also prefer workspace name first in crumbs: "{Workspace} / Models / {Model}".
Josh: Routing question: should we encode breadcrumbs into the path or compute from route? I vote compute from route metadata to avoid diverging stale crumbs.
Kevin: Compute, but ensure permalinks store canonical workspace id in path. Example inconsistent case: /models/123 vs /w/alpha/models/123 — prefer latter for canonical permalinks.
Marta: UX micro-issue: when sidebar regroups, we lose muscle memory for people who used 'Projects' grouping. Suggest temporary tooltip: "Projects moved to Workspaces > Projects" on first session.
Anna: Also keyboard nav: Left/Right arrow should collapse/expand groups; Enter should go to first item. Add role="tree" semantics for keyboard handling.
Sam (PM): Action items:
1) Engineering: implement ?panel=drawer pattern + history push/pop (owner: Josh)
2) Design: add aria-current and keyboard affordance specs to nav component (owner: Anna)
3) PM: update canonical permalink pattern to include /w/:id for model/org-level resources (owner: Sam)
4) Docs: onboarding tooltip copy for relocated groups (owner: Marta)
Kevin: Estimate needed for (1) and (2) — Josh, Anna, can you post estimates in this thread by EOD?
Josh: Will do. Quick note — need to coordinate with runtime routing so SSR/permalink rendering matches client behavior (avoid flash of wrong nav highlight).
Anna: Sounds good. I'll update Figma with a small prototype showing drawer URL behavior and keyboard flows.
Marta: Thanks! I'll draft the tooltip copy and a11y checklist.
Sam (PM): Great. If anyone wants to prototype alternate breadcrumb behavior (workspace-first vs resource-first), ping me and we'll schedule a quick sync. :thumbsup:
Anna: Closing loop: recording this thread into design doc -> https://docs.redwood.ai/console/nav-reorg (will attach snapshots).
